leadership.name: Alexander Kireytsev
leadership.quote:
The mission of JSC ECRT is to create modern, safe, and reliable solutions for railway rolling stock, as well as subsystems and infrastructure assets, using advanced technologies.

We will keep building competencies step by step until our developments rank among the best in the world.
